messages:
Alicia: Quick sync — over the weekend we saw a spike where private endpoint reconciliation churned and caused transient 99p latency regressions for a handful of tenants. Looking for low-risk operator patterns to avoid SLA blips while still converging state. Thoughts?
Bhavik: Ugh. Do we know cause? flapping ENIs, route propagation delays, or our operator thrashing? :eyes:
Alicia: Mix — some were owner-side route propagation lag, some were IAM/SG drift from infra-as-code runs. Operator retried aggressively and we created a tight retry storm.
Carla: Short term we should add a jitter/backoff and a grace window for endpoint flips. If a change flips twice in <5m, don't reconcile immediately.
Eric: Agree. Also add a circuit breaker per-tenant: after N failed reconciles within T, pause active reconciles and alert. Avoids cascading retries.
DevOps: We could make this pluggable in the operator config so customers with strict carve-outs can opt-in/opt-out. Default to conservative behavior.
Alicia: Proposed config snippet (draft):
```
reconcile:
  mode: soft   # soft|strict
  grace_period: 300s
  max_backoff: 15m
  circuit_breaker_threshold: 3
```
Carla: Love the soft/strict toggle. For strict mode (dedicated customers) we still need a fast path but with quota so we don't flood. Maybe token-bucket per-region.
Bhavik: Token-bucket + leader-election for operator instances for a given tenant region. Leader does aggressive reconcile, followers back off. Keeps cross-instance storms down.
deploy-bot: deploy request: rollout/private-endpoint-operator v2.4 -> staging :rocket:
SRE-oncall: Important: whatever we do, we need a mitigation playbook. If reconcilers pause, apps should still hit regional public endpoints as fallback for P0 routes. Need clear docs and runbook.
Maria: Fallback + masking is ok for short windows. We should annotate routes with priority so operator knows which endpoints can failover automatically vs require manual.
Eric: Can we surface a metric: reconcile_pause_count, reconcile_flap_rate, tenant_circuit_opened. Dashboards + alert thresholds.
Carla: Add a histogram for reconcile latency too. Correlate with route table change events from cloud provider logs.
Alicia: Rollout plan idea: canary 10% low-traffic tenants with soft mode + metrics, monitor 48h, then 50%, then all. We'll keep strict mode enabled only for committed dedicated customers.
Bhavik: One more: expose a "suppress-reconcile-until" annotation so infra tools can schedule large infra drift windows (e.g., migrations) without operator fighting them.
DevOps: Good call. Also add validation to avoid accidental long suppress windows. Max 24h by default.
SRE-oncall: Add alert -> Pager for circuit_opened on production dedicated customers. Non-dedicated get email slack only.
Maria: I'll draft runbook entries for failover and operator pause scenarios.
Alicia: Thanks. I'll open a PR with config + canary rollout script and link runbook drafts. Tagging @Bhavik @Carla for review. :+1:
